Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas, where a vehicle operated by Driver 1 was struck
from behind by a vehicle operated by Driver 2. Driver 1 was stopped at a signalized intersection when the impact
occurred. A passenger was seated in the front seat of Driver 1's vehicle and was also in the vehicle when officers
arrived, a fact confirmed by both drivers and the responding officers. Driver 1 reported a wrist injury and was
transported for evaluation. The reported injury is consistent with the type and force of this collision. Damage to the
rear of Driver 1's vehicle is largely in line with the described impact, and no prior damage to the vehicle is known to
officers. Scene photographs confirm several details reported by the drivers. No independent witnesses were located
at the scene. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the applicable auto policy.
</page>
